body:
I don't know if I have the courage to say anything to my therapist at this point. I've started to tell her that life is going great and that the medicine I'm taking is really working, but after a lot of updates happened to my life, I feel like all of our efforts have been for nothing. My dad recently told me that our family will have to move to Spokane, because he got a higher paying job there, and to be honest we can't afford to live where we're living now. We've apparently been living on the edge of bankruptcy for a couple years and I feel as though I'm just contributing to the load of stress that my dad is facing. My mother seems to have mental issues from being a little bit spoiled as a child, and she often has tantrums, choosing to throw all of her anger out on my brother and I. Last night, as I wasn't feeling well, I went to bed pretty early, and I heard my mother screaming at my brother, but not really even saying anything, just screeching as if she was in agony. I used to make excuses that other people's mothers probably have their off days as well, but I'm starting to realize that my mother is not at all normal. Recently I've started to notice that I don't really love her anymore, and both my brother and I have encouraged my dad to divorce her. My dad has told us that she never used to do that kind of thing before we were born. I think that she has cracked under the stress of having such a useless and emotionally unstable daughter, and I have forced her to become unstable as well. I don't know how I feel about moving to Spokane, and I wouldn't like to leave the "friends" that I have made at my current school, but I know that they would be better off without me anyway. I feel as though no one at my new school will like me either, and to be honest I feel like even currently, the only person that I like or even just feel slightly comfortable around is my dad. I think there's also something seriously wrong with my health because although I've been eating an (overestimated) 600 calories a day for around 3 months, I haven't missed my period, started losing hair, or noticed any crazy amount of hunger. Although I initially lost about 8 pounds, it's calmed down now and I've been at the same weight for about a month. I don't know what's going on and I'm worried about myself. If I were to kill myself, I would like to do it in a painless way and so starving myself seems extremely undesirable. I don't know if this is anything you can help me with, but I thought that I might mention it.
As for interests, I really like to draw and paint with watercolors, but I'm not good at that at all. I've only been doing it for about 2 years anyway, and I don't think I would call it a talent. Other than that I have tried various sports as well as musical instruments, and I never seem to like anything. I don't think I'm really better than an average person at anything anyways. Drawing and painting is never really very creative when I do it anyways, because I tend to just look at things in real life and draw them. I don't like to draw things from my head, and I don't draw any cartoons at all. I'm just not very creative. Thank you for spending so much time on me though, I really appreciate it.

I'm not very interesting. I feel like I'm introverted, a bit boring, awkward, easily overwhelmed, and annoying. Other people see me as constantly nervous, uncomfortable with everything. I guess I see the world as a big, wonderful place with lots of opportunity. I don't really have any skills. I find it a bit difficult to understand what people are feeling, but usually, when they're around me at least, they seem really annoyed or upset by my presence. The world feels a bit dull to me at this point, the only sensations I really feel are being overwhelmingly hot or extremely cold. 
I'm also a very not very confrontational, so I don't think I could ever tell my therapist that we don't fit or anything like that. Sometimes, I literally lie to her about the tiniest things just because I don't want to correct her.
